content.short: Intract is a Web3 quest and learn-to-earn platform enabling users to discover, learn about, and earn from blockchain projects on Mantle.
content.description: Intract is a learn-to-earn and community growth platform that connects Web3 users with blockchain projects through structured educational quests. Users complete on-chain and off-chain tasks to learn about protocols, earn rewards, and build their on-chain reputation. For projects, Intract provides a powerful user acquisition and education tool that ensures users genuinely understand the protocol before receiving rewards. Multiple Mantle ecosystem projects use Intract to educate and onboard users to their platforms.
